Effect: Cell damage or unsafe charge outside allowed temperature
Critical control: Use traceable pack, hardware thermal strategy, qualified keyed harness and charger-state validation independent of app health.
Closure evidence: V02–V05 pack limits, thermal traces and independent review

Effect: Stress on pouch, lens or USB, or unwanted key shutdown
Critical control: Freeze worst-case pack/PCM/harness envelope. Measure glass and power-cap stack; pilot selectable cap/seat options.
Closure evidence: V10, V13, V14 dimensional and pressure records

Effect: Reduced range or device fails authorization
Critical control: Agree board and antenna grant/use conditions, final hand/accessory configs, and emissions pre-scan.
Closure evidence: V17 and V24 lab assessment by region

Effect: Loss of angle sensing or escape of an accessible part
Critical control: Positive retention, rated cure/process, strain and wear testing after realistic abuse.

Effect: Bus errors, supply resets, false strikes and shifting encoder zero
Critical control: Freeze keyed nets and route; measure fast-mode margins, rail response, motor coupling and EMI.

Effect: Failed update, disabled recovery or behavior changes across board lots
Critical control: Owner signing process, staged interruption tests, supplier PCNs and API compatibility fixture.
Closure evidence: V01, V20, V21 known-good rollback/reflash report

Effect: Cost overruns and returned units erase margin
Critical control: Timed pilot builds, rework Pareto, supplier quotes and region-specific cost model.
Closure evidence: V25 signed unit economics and early return reasons
